category: Bedrock console gateway (Xbox Live friend bot)

free_tier.stated: The core MCGateway transfer service is free and is intended to remain free.

egress.terms: No byte allowance is published and none would apply: the service is a bot the player friends, not a port.; ingress: none

interface_detail: No API is described; access is through the Minecraft Friends tab and a Discord for server-owner tickets.
tooling: Minecraft client only; no agent, no CLI
chaining: Composes with any Bedrock host, including one behind another vendor's UDP tunnel, but adds nothing itself.

limits.value: the transfer requires an access bot to accept a friend request first; no address is issued to the server owner

binding_note: There is no public address or port to meter, so no byte allowance is ever reached. The gate is the shape of the service: a player joins a bot's world and is transferred from inside the game.

identity_cost.detail: An Xbox Live account to friend the bot: 'Add an available MCGateway bot, wait for the automatic friend acceptance, then join MCGateway Hub.' No Microsoft password is asked for.

reliability_note: Friend acceptance 'usually takes around 20 to 30 seconds and can take up to 60 seconds'; a stale Friends list needs a game restart; the bot fleet is the only path.
confidence_note: The join flow is quoted in full on the front page; whether a server owner can obtain any address was checked on the front page only, and the detailed guide was not read.

evidence.proved: 'Add an access bot, join the MCGateway Hub through your Friends tab, and choose where you want to go.'
'Open the Hub menu with the robot or Ender Pearl, choose Add Server, enter the Bedrock IP and port, then transfer.' The destination is dialled by the bot, not by the player
'The core MCGateway transfer service is free and is intended to remain free.'

notes: This is the Bedrock-specific answer was asked to find, and it is the inverse of what was wanted: a free way for a console player to reach an arbitrary Bedrock server, with no free public UDP endpoint handed to the server owner. It solves the console's missing address box, not the host's missing port.

extras.wg_detail: No WireGuard and no address to reach: the transfer runs inside Minecraft's Friends list.
extras.volume_stated: No byte allowance is published and none would apply: the service is a bot the player friends, not a port.
extras.transit_note: The bot's Xbox Live session relays the player into the destination server.
